# In-app notification centre

## What

Build real-time event stream, mute / categorise, digest email fallback, mobile push parity for our B2B SaaS product (with admin/RBAC needs).

## Why

Reduce friction in admin onboarding; enterprise pipeline asks.

## Scope

- **In scope:** real-time event stream, mute / categorise, digest email fallback, mobile push parity
- **Out of scope:** white-label / custom branding; other identity providers (only the chosen one)
- **Existing constraints:** auth middleware is JWT-only; refactor needed for multi-identity support

## Constraints

- Existing SMB-tier users must continue working unchanged.
- Self-serve where possible; minimise admin friction.
- We have a Q3 deadline tied to sales kickoff; leadership has asked for GA by then.
- Scale context: 10k-100k MAU, 30-80 eng.

## What success looks like

- Adoption: ≥55% of eligible users in 30 days post-launch.
- No security incidents related to the change.
- Support team can resolve common issues self-serve in <15 minutes.
